candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Metrics show /v1/checkout 200s and no dependency-operation series, which does not confirm the 500 path; the 60s window may not align with the alert traces.
missing_evidence: Order service server-side logs/traces for the failing POST /v1/orders requests

candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show gateway client calls to order:8000 failing with 500 Internal Server Error, so the checkout 502s originate from order-side 500s.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency) is not yet distinguished; only the order-side 500 is established.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are explained by order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders, seen consistently in traces and logs. The specific order-side fault is not yet established, so a bounded http-500 candidate is offered with remaining evidence gaps noted.
missing_evidence: Order service telemetry (logs, traces, metrics) for the failing requests
